column1: # Custom partition table for Hey Vaani ESP32 firmware
#   phy_init: PHY calibration data (required for WiFi)
#   factory: Main application firmware (~1.5 MB needed for TFLite + model)
# Note: model_data.h (46.9 KB) is compiled INTO the firmware binary
# so "factory" partition must be large enough for full app.
# Run "idf.py size" after build to verify actual usage.
